scope: General physical-card zone model and strict action-policy boundary only; not a new Magic rules engine, paired effects comparison, or game/turn-win simulator

coverage.companion_policy: Companion is external to 100-card decks where documented; never inferred to be a card in the shuffled main library.

contract: Import all 62 authoritative deck entries via the current registry/summary and existing frozen Scryfall resolver; preserve 100 physical cards including designated commander(s)
Use unique immutable physical card IDs per game across basic-land repeats, commanders, and all card names
Shuffle entire main library by fixed seed; draw 7 + four further cards with no unsupported mulligan or speculative draw-policy claims
Conserve exact card IDs across command, library, hand, battlefield, graveyard, exile, and stack zones after every action
Fail closed without partial state mutation for invalid zone moves, duplicates, negative mana, unsupported timing or card payment requests
No executable effects on unsupported spells; optional printed-mana affordability inspection cannot imply a legal spell cast
Strict current-turn/land-drop/tap/priority invariants for explicitly modeled basic land plays, while all conditional and nonbasic land ETB behaviors remain unresolved
Use deterministic, recorded policy decisions with explicit limitations; hash paired deterministic replay for representative deck samples
Prove no cross-deck card contamination, no unexplained card creation or disappearance, no exact-card substitutions and no protected file changes
Produce a per-deck summary and aggregate for all 62 decks; do not issue upgrade/cut, bracket, win-rate, formal review or zero-improvement claims

fixed_policy.draws: Opening 7 cards, then exactly four further draws without skips (synthetic sampling of access, not real Commander turns)
fixed_policy.unsupported: explicit blocked outcome with no mutation
fixed_policy.mana_preflight: Use pip-matching only for static printed costs where possible; never model cost increases, cost reductions, additional costs, alt/free costs, priority triggers or effects
fixed_policy.land_plays: only basic lands with unconditional untapped entry; nonbasic lands fail closed until Oracle ETB decisions are specified
fixed_policy.interaction: no actions by simulated opponents; no sampling opponent distribution

missing_capabilities: No full stack/priority and replacement rules, triggered abilities, token/mass-zone operations, mana optimizer or all-land legality
No actual shuffling/searching/drawing from card effects, except explicitly tested state operations
No turn-skipping, card draw probability inference from these four samples, actual opening-hand keep policy or game win rates
No simulated casting or card-effect resolution integrated from prior Abaddon interpreter in this cycle
Every commander still requires independent identity and candidate analyses, Phase B experiments, critic/reconciliation, I/J and user reviews

expected_output.receipt_per_deck: list hash, commander count, physical main library count, fixed-seed hand/draw digests, exact zone conservation results and explicit unsupported boundaries

source_id_provenance_reconciliation.rule: Do not require matching legacy and normalized deck ID keys. Match exact unique slug and require each divergent source ID to equal the registry deck_id_provenance.source_deck_id; otherwise hard fail. Record every confirmed alias as evidence; do not mutate either authority or source summary.
